title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description: About Us Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Video Editor
description: Ten16 Creative is a boutique creative agency that builds campaigns, brand systems, and content for technology and AI-driven companies. We value your perspective! What we're looking for: Strong portfolio showing both video editing and motion graphics work Proficiency in After Effects, Premiere (or similar NLE) Experience with (or genuine curiosity about) AI-generated video tools Ability to work independently, manage your time, and meet deadlines Great taste in design, knowledge of the latest video editing trends and styles. Bonus points: Experience creating content for tech, SaaS, or consumer brands, Basis English. But don't worry, your teammates are also based in Brazil. We use the latest AI tools to move fast and deliver high-quality work for ambitious companies. If you want creative freedom, variety, and the chance to grow with us, please don't hesitate to apply. ------ Estamos Contratando: Editor de Vídeo / Motion Designer (Brasil, Remoto) A Ten16 Creative é uma agência criativa boutique que desenvolve campanhas, sistemas de marca e conteúdo para empresas de tecnologia e inteligência artificial. Trabalhamos com marcas que você já conhece — e algumas que está prestes a conhecer. Estamos procurando um Editor de Vídeo + Motion Designer baseado no Brasil para integrar nosso time em tempo integral. A posição é 100% remota, com reporte direto ao nosso Diretor Criativo. O que você vai fazer: Editar conteúdo em vídeo para campanhas, redes sociais, lançamentos de produto e storytelling de marca Criar motion graphics — de animações de logo a sequências completas de explainer Experimentar com ferramentas de vídeo com IA (Runway, Higgsfield, etc.) para expandir os limites criativos Entregar em múltiplos formatos: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 — para web, social, ads e mais Trabalhar rápido, pensar criativamente e trazer ideias — não apenas executar briefings O que estamos buscando: Portfólio sólido mostrando trabalhos de edição de vídeo e motion graphics Domínio de After Effects, Premiere (ou similar) Experiência com (ou curiosidade genuína sobre) ferramentas de vídeo gerado por IA Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente, gerenciar seu tempo e cumprir prazos Bom gosto. Sério — a gente se importa com craft. Pontos extras: Experiência criando conteúdo para marcas de tech, SaaS ou consumer Conforto para trabalhar em inglês (nossos clientes são dos EUA) Aqui não é fábrica. Somos um time pequeno fazendo trabalho de alta qualidade para empresas ambiciosas. Se você quer liberdade criativa, variedade e a chance de crescer com a gente — manda seu portfólio aqui embaixo ou me chama no DM.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description: About iQIYI iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences. Role purpose Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision. Key responsibilities 1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations. Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred. Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage. Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Analista De Vendas Internas Jr
description: Atuando desde 1939, a Mercury Marine se consolidou como destaque global na fabricação de motores de popa e soluções para navegação. Com presença sólida no Brasil, atuamos com foco em inovação, confiabilidade, qualidade e alto desempenho, oferecendo produtos e serviços que atendem aos mais altos padrões do mercado náutico visando a satisfação máxima de nossos clientes e usuários. A operação brasileira integra a Brunswick Corporation , um dos maiores grupos do setor marítimo mundial, e combina tecnologia de ponta com compromisso com a excelência e sustentabilidade. Buscamos um(a) ANALISTA DE VENDAS INTERNAS JR para atuar junto ao time comercial em nosso escritório no Rio de Janeiro e contribuir no fortalecimento do time de operação de vendas, o relacionamento com clientes e a interface com diferentes áreas da empresa. Principais atividades: Emitir e acompanhar pedidos de vendas, garantindo informações corretas de preços, prazos e especificações; Prestar suportea clientes internos e externos, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre pedidos, disponibilidade de produtos e remessas; Coordenar o fluxo de pedidos junto às áreas de Supply Chain e Financeiro, assegurando o faturamento e a entrega; Atualizar informações comerciais e apoiar processos de importação quando necessário; Monitorar remessas e manter clientes informados sobre o status das entregas; Atuar em parceria com as equipes de Vendas e Financeiro para garantir agilidade nos processos e atendimento às necessidades dos clientes; Contribuir paraa melhoria contínua dos processos, propondo procedimentos e padronizações para otimizar o fluxo de vendas. Para essa posição, o que o profissional precisa ser/ter? Ter ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas. Ter inglês intermediário Ter domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel. Desejável ter conhecimento em sistemas ERP (Dynamics AX será considerado um diferencial) Quanto às soft skills, buscamos alguém que tenha: Boa comunicação e habilidade para se relacionar com pessoas de diferentes níveis da organização e com nossa carteira de clientes em todo o Brasil; Afinidade com números, planilhas e ferramentas de análise de dados, especialmente Excel; Interesse em aprender continuamente; Facilidade paratrabalhar em equipe; Capacidade de solucionar problemas e propor soluções; Perfil organizado e analítico. É legal saber que... Buscamos oferecer um ambiente de trabalho agradável ao nosso time Trabalhamos no modelo híbrido: 2 dias de home office e 3 dias presenciais. A quarta-feira é nosso dia fixo de trabalho presencial. Adotamos jornada flexível, de segunda a sexta-feira, totalizando 40 horas semanais. Temos ginástica laboral 2 vezes por semana no escritório Pacote de remuneração (Salário + benefícios): Alelo Multi benefícios R$2.452,40 (por mês, sem desconto e mantido nas férias); Plano de saúde (colaborador e dependentes, sem desconto em folha e sem coparticipação); Plano odontológico (colaborador e dependentes, sem desconto em folha e sem coparticipação); Seguro de vida em grupo; Vale transporteou Vale Estacionamento; Day-off de aniversário; Convênios e parcerias; > > > Modelo de contratação: vaga terceirizada, por meio do Grupo Seres, em contrato por tempo indeterminado. Sobre o processo seletivo, é constituído por algumas etapas, sendo: 1ª etapa: análise e triagem de currículos 2ª etapa: entrevista com RH - análise para aderência à vaga + testagem de inglês 3ª etapa: entrevista com gestor direto - somente os candidatos previamente aprovados 4ª etapa: entrevista com diretor da área - somente finalista(s)

Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions. To verify and monitor all HSEQ activities in the operation of the Fleet and to ensure that adequate resources and shore-based support is applied as required. Investigate any accidents, incidents, near misses and unsafe observations on-board fleet vessels and make recommendations to prevent a recurrence. Ensure pro-active follow-up on corrective actions with vessels as required. Share any safe / best practices on-board fleet vessels are recognized and shared. Act as a member of the Emergency Response Team during an emergency. Compliance Act as Company Security Officer (CSO) and plan internal ISPS audits for designated fleet/vessels within the required timescales. Collaborating with the shipboard team and the Fleet Superintendent, prepare vessels for inspection/audit by PSC, Flag, Oil Major and similar bodies as a shared responsibility. Arrange third party inspections such as Oil Major, CDI and flag state inspections and co-ordinate response. Plan and control internal audits for assigned vessels, utilizing Group resources as appropriate Plan and control external audits for assigned vessels by the auditing authority Maintain navigational standards by regular review of navigational practices, procedures, and any improvements required for assigned vessels. Ensure all vessels have an annual sailing navigation audit, or equivalent Remote VDR audit. Monitor shipboard drug and alcohol testing. Act as Deputy DPA when required, and to assist and support the DPA to monitor as a minimum the following for his or her assigned vessels: Communication and implementation of the safety and environmental protection policy; Evaluation and review of the effectiveness of the safety management system; Reporting and analysis of non-conformities, accidents and hazardous occurrences; Maintain ISM certification and organising and monitoring of internal audits; Appropriate revisions to the SMS; and Ensuring that adequate resources and shore based support is provided. Operational Management Prepare ‘visitation plans’ to gain thorough familiarization of assigned vessels, safety equipment, challenges and safety culture onboard. Following inspection, issue safety inspection reports to the company standard along with remedial actions required. Co-ordinate the provision of specialist advice on all marine and operational matters, actively promoting and supporting the development of effective professional working partnerships between Senior Officers onboard vessels and the ship management team ashore. Handle/liaise with the Master on P&I and Insurance claims, when required Evaluate vessel requirements with regard to mooring ropes, marine and safety equipment. Client Relationship & Performance Management Provide timely and accurate information to Clients on all marine and operational matters, ensuring HSEQ input to client reports. Participate in the weekly Customer Temperature Dashboard review meetings, collaborating with the shore team to formulate robust action plans to drive improvement in performance of office and customer KPIs. Collect HSEQ statistical data of the fleet to support the CTD and Management Review processes. People Management Authorise selection process of Senior Officers for assigned Vessels. Brief Senior Officers during office visits on VMS, fleet requirements, vessel work plan etc. Ensure they have an understanding of the V. Ships values and are clear about the standards of performance expected and support available from the team ashore. Build and maintain a professional and effective working relationship with senior ship staff to influence the development of a strong safety culture. Conduct Senior Officer Performance Appraisals in accordance with VMS procedures and as play an active role in their personal development. What can I expect in return? V. title: Gerente de biogás
description: A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local. A Regenera Rio: Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, vindos de casas, comércios e indústrias, garantindo que tenham um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento. Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a criação de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia de reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável. Essa transformação resulta na redução de impactos ambientais causados pela disposição incorreta dos resíduos, em melhorias diretas na saúde e qualidade de vida da população carioca e no avanço da economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente. Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características. Principais Responsabilidades: - Liderar a operação de biogás e biometano, desde o campo de gás até a entrega do produto para o parceiro terceirizado. - Gerir times de campo e escritório, incluindo operação 24 horas da planta. - Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Aterro, Chorume e Logística. - Garantir a performance operacional, segurança, continuidade e eficiência da planta. - Desenvolver e executar o plano de crescimento do negócio de biogás, apoiando o aumento de receita. - Atuar como peça-chave na estratégia de expansão do grupo no setor de resíduos, com potencial de participação em novos projetos e ativos do Regenera. - Apoiar tecnicamente a evolução da operação, considerando a mudança tecnológica do setor (de geração de energia para purificação de biogás e produção de biometano). - Trabalhar na formação técnica da equipe, considerando que o mercado brasileiro possui escassez de especialistas em biogás e campo de gás. Principais Desafios da Posição: - Atuar em uma operação de altíssima complexidade e escala, referência no Brasil e América Latina. - Gerenciar a maior produção de biogás do país, proveniente de resíduos domiciliares com alta carga orgânica. - Conduzir uma operação crítica para o resultado financeiro do negócio, com forte impacto em receita. - Estruturar e desenvolver um modelo de gestão mais eficiente, menos reativo e mais estratégico. - Superar a escassez de especialistas em biogás no mercado brasileiro, exigindo formação e desenvolvimento interno. - Apoiar a visão da Aegea de transformar resíduos em um novo pilar de negócio, replicável nacionalmente. Requisitos e Formação: Formação superior em: engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Produção, Química. Experiência em operações industriais, ambientais, resíduos, energia, gás ou plantas de processo contínuo. Vivência com operação de campo, plantas 24h e times técnicos. Experiência em: Biogás, Biometano, Aterro sanitário, Tratamento de resíduos, Plantas de purificação de gases ou processos industriais similares; Capacidade de atuar em ambiente operacional pesado, com visão estratégica. Informações adicionais: Assistência médica; Assistência odontológica; Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional); Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro); Seguro de vida; Vale transporte; Gympass; Vale alimentação e/ou refeição; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados; Kit office. Necessário ter disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no escritório da Renenera na cidade de Seropédica/RJ de segunda a sexta das 8h às 18h.

description: Responsável por liderar e executar atividades comerciais, com foco em atendimento ao cliente, vendas ativas e gestão de desempenho da equipe. Controlar a acuracidade de OCR e traçar ações para garantir que ela atinja os padrões determinados pela Receita Federal; Garantir junto aos encarregados de operações e ao especialista de equipamentos que todos os equipamentos e veículos em operação estejam em condições gerais de funcionamento e com as eventuais documentações /certificações em dia; Participar do estudo para implantação de medidas emergenciais, de acordo com as situações que possam ocorrer no desenvolvimento das atividades, de modo a buscar soluções eficazes e que não representem aumento de custo para o terminal; Realizar diariamente o diálogo de segurança, focando nos riscos inerentes da operação e garantindo o correto preenchimento do controle de presença; Interagir com a área de manutenção para garantir o melhor desempenho dos equipamentos; Difundir a sustentabilidade dentro de seu ambiente de trabalho. Difundir a sustentabilidade dentro de seu ambiente de trabalho; Cumprir e fazer cumprir o procedimento de amarração /desamarração, conforme treinamento; Executar outrasatividades, caso haja necessidade imperiosa, com o mesmo grau de complexidade, de acordo com solicitações do Gestor da área e/ou recomendações do médico do trabalho; Cumprir com os procedimentos e instruções relativas à função, bem como as normas e procedimentos gerais da empresa; Garantir que o SGI alcance seus resultados pretendidos dentro de sua esfera de competência. Direcionar, engajar e apoiar os colaboradores para que contribuam para a eficácia do sistema, promovendo a cultura de segurança, a prevenção de poluição e o foco no cliente. Assegurar a provisão de recursos necessários para a execução segura, padronizada e eficiente das atividades operacionais sob sua responsabilidade; Assegurar cumprimento das diretrizes estabelecidas pela Política do SGI, atuando em conformidade com os procedimentos internos e legislações vigentes; É responsabilidade inerente ao cargo descrito relatar ativamente quaisquer desvios de qualidade, incidentes, condições inseguras ou impactos ambientais adversos, contribuindo para a eliminação de perigos, redução de riscos e para a melhoria contínua do SGI; Executar as rotinas visando o atendimento aos requisitos da atividade e a satisfação do cliente, zelando pela padronização e mitigação de falhas; Zelar pela própria integridade física e de terceiros, utilizar adequadamente os EPIs, cumprir as regras de segurança do trabalho e exercer o direito de recusa diante de riscos iminentes não controlados. Garantir a correta segregação de resíduos gerados durante sua atividade, promover o uso racional de recursos e atuar de forma preventiva contra vazamentos e outros passivos ambientais. REMUNERAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS: Salário compatível com o mercado. Pacote de benefícios completo: assistência médica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, entre outros. Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e crescimento na carreira. LOCAL DE TRABALHO: Rio de Janeiro - RJ

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description: Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads. Key Responsibilities 1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Digital designer (marketing)

We provide beginning-to-end strategy, design and production services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies. We're looking for a Digital Designer (Marketing) to join our team and work primarily with our retainer clients. Unlike project-based work, you'll develop deep, ongoing relationships with a portfolio of clients, becoming an extension of their marketing teams and developing an intimate understanding of their brands, audiences, and business goals. You'll report to both the Design Team Lead and Head of Creative and Strategy, working across a wide range of marketing assets. This role requires a designer who thrives on variety, works quickly without sacrificing quality, and has a deep understanding of marketing asset creation across digital channels. Key Responsibilities Marketing Asset Creation - Designing social media content across platforms (, Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook), including static posts, carousels, and stories - Creating webinar and event graphics, including promotional banners, registration pages, presentation templates, and recap assets - Developing one-pagers, sell sheets, and product/feature overviews - Designing email headers, newsletter templates, and digital campaign assets - Creating infographics, data visualizations, and report layouts - Designing blog graphics, featured images, and content marketing visuals - Producing landing page designs and website banners - Creating presentation decks for sales, investors, and internal use - Designing trade show and event collateral (booth graphics, handouts, signage) - Adapting and resizing assets for multiple formats and platforms Brand Stewardship - Maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints for assigned clients - Building and maintaining template libraries and asset repositories - Contributing to design system development and documentation - Evolving client brands within established guidelines while keeping them fresh Collaboration & Process - Working under the supervision of the Design Team Lead while maintaining direct communication with leadership - Collaborating closely with Account Managers to understand client priorities and deadlines - Managing multiple client requests simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail - Participating in client calls and incorporating feedback quickly - Working efficiently within retainer hour allocations Key KPIs - Operational Efficiency: Deviation from estimates - Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Average score 4.7+ - Internal Quality Score: Average score 4.7+ - Client Creative Feedback: Average score 4.7+ - Turnaround Time: Meeting SLAs for retainer deliverables Requirements - 3-5+ years of experience in marketing design, preferably at an agency or in-house marketing team - Deep experience with marketing asset types: social media graphics, webinar materials, one-pagers, email templates, presentations, infographics - Strong understanding of social media platforms and their design requirements/best practices - Expert proficiency in Figma (primary tool) - Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, In Design) - Proficiency with AI tools - Experience with motion/animation tools a plus (After Effects, Lottie) - Ability to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality - Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple client accounts - Comfortable with remote collaboration via Slack, video calls, and project management tools - Strong portfolio demonstrating range across marketing asset types Nice to Have - Experience working with B2 B technology brands - Basic motion design / animation skills - Experience with Hub Spot, Marketo, or other marketing automation platforms - Understanding of conversion-focused design principles - Experience building and maintaining design systems The Perks - Diverse team (team members are based in US, UK, Europe, Canada, LATAM) - Working with interesting clients in the technology space - Fully remote - A highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development - Salary is commensurate with experience and market-rate at the candidate's location

title: Sr arquiteto de soluções sap fi-co
description: Aqui na Zallpy, tecnologia nasce de pessoas curiosas, colaborativas e com vontade de fazer bem feito. Se você gosta de ambientes onde existe espaço para perguntar, testar, aprender e evoluir junto, se liga nessa oportunidade! Incentivamos especialmente a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e garantimos um ambiente acessível, com adaptações e suporte ao longo da jornada. Também encorajamos pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIA+ e profissionais de diferentes origens a se candidatarem. Aqui, você pode ser quem é, em cada fase da sua jornada. Vem com a gente. Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar em um time que pensa grande, trabalha com atenção aos detalhes, parceria no dia a dia e responsabilidade compartilhada. Acreditamos em autonomia, troca entre diferentes experiências e soluções construídas em conjunto. Por aqui, crescer significa compartilhar conhecimento, respeitar diferentes formas de pensar e construir relações de confiança enquanto entregamos tecnologia de qualidade. Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, vem somar com a gente. O que você vai fazer: Liderar a definição da arquitetura funcional e técnica de soluções SAP end-to-end, envolvendo múltiplos módulos e integrações. Atuar na concepção de soluções para projetos de implementação, evolução e migração para SAP S/4 HANA. Apoiar processos de pré-venda, contribuindo na elaboração de propostas técnicas, definição de soluções e estimativas de esforço. Definir estratégias de integração entre ambientes SAP, sistemas legados e demais aplicações corporativas. Avaliar impactos de mudanças, garantindo aderência à arquitetura corporativa e às melhores práticas do ecossistema SAP. Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de desenvolvimento, consultoria funcional e gestão de projetos. Conduzir a estratégia de Clean Core em ambientes SAP S/4 HANA, promovendo soluções sustentáveis e escaláveis. Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, como Financeiro, Operações, Manufatura, Supply Chain e Comercial, traduzindo necessidades em soluções de arquitetura. O que estamos buscando: Experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções SAP. Vivência como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, Arquiteto Corporativo, Especialista SAP ou Líder de Arquitetura. Participação em projetos de implementação, transformação ou migração para SAP S/4 HANA. Experiência em processos de pré-venda e desenho de soluções do ecossistema SAP. Conhecimento aprofundado dos processos de negócio, especialmente Financeiro, Compras, Vendas e Produção. Experiência com arquitetura de integração entre soluções SAP e sistemas corporativos. Conhecimento das metodologias de implementação SAP (Activate ou similares). Vivência em ambientes complexos, multiempresas e de grande porte. Capacidade de atuar junto a executivos, stakeholders de negócio e equipes multidisciplinares. Será um diferencial se você: Possuir inglês avançado. Ter experiência com SAP S/4 HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Fiori, SAP BTP e SAP Integration Suite. Possuir visão funcional integrada dos módulos FI, MM e SD. Ter experiência com estratégias de Clean Core e arquitetura orientada a boas práticas SAP. Ser capaz de orquestrar especialistas técnicos e funcionais na construção de soluções de arquitetura. Possuir certificações atualizadas em SAP relacionadas à arquitetura, SAP S/4 HANA ou SAP BTP. Onde você vai trabalhar: Esta é uma posição para atuação remota Modalidades de contratação CLT. Cooperado. Benefícios de ser um Zallper: Vale Alimentação/Refeição Cartão multibenefícios Caju, em formato crédito, oferecendo flexibilidade para o dia a dia. Aqui, a confiança está diretamente ligada à qualidade das entregas, ao cumprimento de prazos e ao comprometimento com resultados. title: Sr. workday financials consultant
description: Senior Workday Financials Consultant About the Role Aspire is looking for a Senior Workday Financials Consultant to join our Finance Solution Delivery team on a contract basis. In this role, you will serve as a versatile Workday Financials subject matter expert , supporting production operations, system enhancements, and strategic Finance transformation initiatives. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the Workday Financials platform remains stable, scalable, and continuously optimized. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Workday Financials professional who can work independently, solve complex problems, and provide hands-on expertise across multiple Financials domains. Key Responsibilities Provide hands-on configuration, administration, and production support across Workday Financials. Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions. Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities. Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health. Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with technical and functional teams on reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements. Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities. Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs. Work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment with stakeholders across U. S. time zones. Required Qualifications 8–10 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience. Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday. Proven experience supporting both production environments and project-based initiatives. Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and systems-thinking skills. Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday Financials domains. Priority Workday Financials Areas Highest Priority Financial Accounting Expenses Business Assets Secondary Priority Banking & Settlement Nice to Have VNDLY experience Lower Priority Procurement experience — the organization is gradually phasing this area out. What Success Looks Like In this role, success means you: Seamlessly support multiple Workday Financials domains based on business priorities. Reduce the production support backlog and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders. Deliver scalable, maintainable solutions rather than short-term fixes. Resolve issues efficiently while minimizing business disruption. Become a trusted extension of the core Workday team. Contribute to continuous improvement and long-term Finance transformation initiatives. Why Aspire? Join a Remote-First organization. Work alongside exceptional technology professionals from around the world. Access continuous technical and professional development opportunities. Gain international exposure by collaborating with global technology leaders. Receive nursery reimbursement benefits. Participate in virtual and onsite international technology conferences. Work within an IT environment aligned with rigorous security and compliance standards, including ISO and SOC frameworks.

Traduzir conceitos técnicos e estratégicos em conteúdos claros, aplicáveis e alinhados à realidade do negócio. Desenvolver treinamentos voltados para processos de pós-vendas, peças, serviços, atendimento ao cliente, vendas e rentabilidade. Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências de liderança, gestão de equipes e melhoria de resultados. Experiência em concessionárias automotivas, especialmente nas áreas de Peças, Oficina, Serviços e Atendimento ao Cliente. Conhecimento dos processos de compras e vendas de peças, varejo e atacado. Vivência na condução de treinamentos e desenvolvimento de conteúdo para equipes operacionais e lideranças. Habilidade para facilitar treinamentos e promover aprendizagem de forma prática e engajadora. Capacidade de conectar aspectos técnicos, comerciais e comportamentais para gerar impacto no desempenho das equipes. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita. Disponibilidade para viagens. Diferenciais Experiência com treinamento corporativo no segmento automotivo. Vivência em programas de desenvolvimento de lideranças. Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem Experiência na utilização de plataformas de aprendizagem e ferramentas digitais de treinamento. Competências Comportamentais Comunicação e influência. Facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal. Protagonismo e senso de dono. Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos. Pensamento analítico e visão de negócio. Colaboração e trabalho em equipe. Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade. Mentalidade de crescimento (Growth Mindset). Perfil Desejado Profissional apaixonado por desenvolvimento de pessoas, com forte conhecimento técnico, comercial e visão de negócio, capaz de atuar como facilitador, consultor e instrutor. Deve ser uma pessoa que compreenda profundamente a realidade das concessionárias e consiga transformar desafios operacionais e comerciais em oportunidades de aprendizagem, contribuindo para o crescimento das equipes, a excelência operacional e os resultados da rede de pós-vendas.

title: Onboarding de parceiros

title: Electrical engineer
description: Position: Electrical Engineer Location: Rio de Janeiro (Barra da Tijuca) About Us MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services. For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide. Job Purpose The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Key Responsibilities Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team; Develop technical solutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO; Provide technical support to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization; Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions; Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P&IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs; Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12. Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering; Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred); Advanced English; Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail; Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies; Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software; Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work. Nice to have Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems. Benefits Meal and food allowances Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay) Life Insurance Annual Bonus Private Pension Plan Childcare Allowance Note This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens. MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.
